note: Nested unique lost its seen-set state: ValueInterpreter.handleUnique builds a fresh GenerationContext per attempt for choice-sequence deduplication and did not carry uniqueSeenKeys or uniqueSeenSequences across, so an inner unique forgot every value it had produced and stopped deduplicating. The value-only engine then yielded a stream the value-and-tree engine never would. Fixed 2026-07-31 in b2a8b427e by threading both sets into the sub-context and back out, matching the single-context accumulation in ValueAndChoiceTreeInterpreter.handleUnique; see InterpreterRNGParityTests. Found by the 2026-07-31 depth-3 campaign.
